当前材料中与问题最相关的是论文PDTrim，其摘要说明该工作面向推理中的预填充-解码（PD）分离场景提出剪枝方法，并构建剪枝集与蒸馏集进行迭代块移除。
[paper-009] · 摘要

该摘要还说明作者分析了预填充阶段与解码阶段的剪枝敏感性，并识别各阶段可移除的块，以适配PD分离部署。

关于性能结果，摘要仅笼统声称在PD分离与PD统一（非分离）设置下均取得较强性能，并可扩展到其他非块剪枝方法；当前材料未给出具体数据集、模型规模、硬件配置或数值指标。

citations.title: PDTrim: Targeted Pruning for Prefill-Decode Disaggregation in Inference
citations.quote: In this paper, we propose a pruning method that is highly integrated with PD disaggregation, enabling more precise pruning of blocks. Our approach constructs pruning and distillation sets to perform iterative block removal, obtaining better pruning solutions.

citations.title: PDTrim: Targeted Pruning for Prefill-Decode Disaggregation in Inference
citations.quote: Moreover, we analyze the pruning sensitivity of the prefill and decode stages and identify removable blocks specific to each stage, making it well suited for PD disaggregation deployment.

citations.title: PDTrim: Targeted Pruning for Prefill-Decode Disaggregation in Inference
citations.quote: Extensive experiments demonstrate our approach consistently achieves strong performance in both PD disaggregation and PD unified (non-PD disaggregation) settings, and can also be extended to other non-block pruning methods.

citations.title: PDTrim: Targeted Pruning for Prefill-Decode Disaggregation in Inference
citations.quote: Under the same settings, our method achieves improved performance and faster inference.
